policy: 8 public API methods: exact default route, inert macros, effective project references/libraries/upload metadata, early forbidden options/upload/Immediate/MATCH, profile files and dangling symlinks, failure propagation, no manifest key
independence: Literal contract-derived expectations authored in reused separate context; no D115 or existing motor production body reads. Existing fixtures reused unchanged. Supplemental direct MotorGate comparison is delegation compatibility, not independent proof of Gate internals.
limits: All true-grant execution is synthetic host Port callbacks; no MCU motor action or upload.
Native owner binding uses ordinary public UnoQPort definitions as a counted substitute, so it does not validate actual pin/timer/readback behavior.
Native new/delete guards cover C++ allocation; Runner guard also wraps C malloc/calloc/realloc/free. Do not call the Native fixture a universal allocator detector.
No measured electrical coast, wheel response, active brake, directional/full-duty reversal, kill, supply or brownout acceptance.
Callback acknowledgements and Gate timestamps are fixture facts, not physical measurements.
No target ABI or bench WCET is inferred from host results.
No reentrant Port misuse is exercised because it is outside the adopted contract.
